usefulness_gate.derivation: A closed integer-code interval spanning at most 18 codes admits an integer centre no more than 9 codes from either endpoint. At maximum retained gain, 9 codes produces 0.0015600609040120617 Hz, below the unchanged 1/600 Hz frequency-RMS allowance and below one 600-second count. Independently, a one-code excursion held for ceil(1/minimum_gain)=6114 seconds has at least one cycle finite area; departure and intentional return cost two path codes. Adding the 9-code worst-case return correction gives 11 path codes, below the 27-code limit. This establishes a non-vacuous prospective region without requiring the historical seven-action trajectory.
